cases.description: Create a master trader account
cases.preconditions: User is registered and passed basic onboarding.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Master Trader registration.
2. Submit nickname, trading bio, strategy tags, and fee structure (e.g. 20% perf fee).
3. Bind broker account credentials.
cases.expected: Master account record created in DB, public profile generated, status set to Active, broker connection verified.
cases.actual: Browser host unavailable; master onboarding, broker binding and KYC UI not executed.

cases.description: Create a follower account
cases.preconditions: User registered and KYC verified.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Follower portal.
2. Create follower trading account.
3. Deposit funds or bind funded broker account.
cases.expected: Follower profile initialized with available margin balance, risk settings defaulted, ready to subscribe.
cases.actual: Browser host unavailable; new follower onboarding, KYC and broker funding workflow not executed.

cases.description: Link follower to master
cases.preconditions: Master account is active; follower account has sufficient free equity.
cases.steps:
1. Follower selects master profile.
2. Click 'Copy Trader' / 'Link Account'.
3. Confirm linking terms.
cases.expected: Linkage established in relational DB; master follower-count increments by 1; link status set to Pending_Activation.
cases.actual: Existing API subscriptions exercised; new UI linkage, terms and Pending_Activation transition not verified.

cases.description: Subscribe follower to master strategy
cases.preconditions: Follower linked to master; allocation mode configured (e.g., multiplier = 1.0).
cases.steps:
1. Set allocation funds ($1,000) and risk parameters.
2. Click 'Start Copying'.
3. Engine registers subscription event.
cases.expected: Subscription state transitions to 'Active'; follower added to master's fan-out Redis pub/sub routing channel.
cases.actual: API link active and receives copy; allocation/risk UI and internal subscription event not inspected
cases.remarks: Partial execution finished; the remaining specified criteria are unverified.

cases.description: Unsubscribe follower from master
cases.preconditions: Follower currently actively copying master.
cases.steps:
1. Follower navigates to subscription settings.
2. Click 'Stop Copying'.
3. Select policy for open positions (keep open vs market close).
cases.expected: Subscription state updated to 'Unsubscribed'; follower removed from execution fan-out; no further master trades copied.
cases.actual: Unsubscribed account received no new master copy; other followers copied
cases.remarks: Browser policy-choice dialog not exercised. Partial execution finished; the remaining specified criteria are unverified.

cases.preconditions: Master and 1+ active followers; market open.
